title: Chapter 163 Dad, You Are Back
content:
Chapter 163 Dad, You Are Back

"Class leader, we met,"

Before Shi Jin finished speaking, he suddenly felt a darkness in front of him.

I saw that the spirit devouring suddenly pressed his heavenly spirit cover with a palm.

"Forget it, stop talking, your mission is over."

The Spirit-Devouring said coldly.

The next moment, Shi Jin widened his eyes and then his body slowly dissipated.

Swallow!

On the side, Shi Heng trembled all over.

But even so, Shi Heng still had no intention of escaping.

In a blink of an eye, the figure of Ezen completely disappeared into the void.

At this time, the spirit-die looked at the Shi Heng.

Suddenly, Shi Heng collapsed directly into the void and smiled bitterly.

"The Spirit-Eating Clan will win in the end."

In the end, the spirit devoured all the two of them, and a terrifying aura suddenly surged out of the spirit devoured.

Rumble!

The entire void began to collapse because it could not bear this aura.

Seeing this scene, Yan Lingyun's face turned gloomy.

"You can never control the power that does not belong to you."

Hearing this, the Spirit-Devouring face looked ferocious.

"It's enough to deal with you!"

At the same time, all the memories of Seige and the others were absorbed by Seige.

He also knew the reason for their Soul-Eating Tribe's failure.

Even if that sword is just felt in memory, it can feel deep despair.

Be careless.

I didn't expect the other party to have such a trump card.

However, he didn't believe that the other party could still have a trump card of that level.

The Spirit-Devouring looked at Yan Lingyun not far away with a serious expression, and then turned around and headed towards the few Spirit-Devouring Army.

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun was shocked and rushed over.

But just swallowing two tribe members at the peak of the mortal realm, his strength has reached unprecedented strength.

Buzz —

A terrifying devouring force surged out of the spirit body.

Suddenly, the entire Spirit-Devouring Army came over.

Sacrifice.

Another sacrifice.

The entire Spirit-Devouring Army began to disappear, and the spirit-Devouring breath became stronger and stronger.

"You all retreat!"

In the void, Yan Lingyun suddenly said.

Upon hearing this, everyone knew that the Spirit-Devouring was not something they could deal with, so they hurriedly retreated behind.

On the other hand, Shi Chen had lost the desire to continue fighting.

He knew that their Spirit-Eating Clan had failed.

If you continue fighting, he will probably be the next one to be swallowed.

Although for them, it is extremely proud to be swallowed by the patriarch.

But he was really unwilling to be able to practice here and be swallowed up like this.

At the same time, he also became a little self-doubted.

Are you really a Soul-Devouring Clan?

"We are not feeling well today, we will fight again next day!"

Shi Chen put down this harsh words and then fled the scene, leaving Jiang Bei and Kong who were a little stunned.

The two looked at each other and then leaned towards the people in the Huangcheng City.

"Brother Jiang, congratulations."

When they saw Jiangbei, everyone congratulated each other.

The eyes of the Divine Dynasty also looked at Jiangbei and the others.

Unexpectedly, if you don’t see it for thousands of years, this martial god has reached such a terrifying level as half a step in the mortal realm.

Immediately, everyone looked at the strange man beside Jiangbei again.

It looks extremely young.

But the aura of the Half-Punch Realm seemed to be slightly stronger than that of Jiangbei.

"Who is your Excellency?"

Huang Shou stepped forward and said in confusion.

Upon hearing this, Kong said lightly: "My name is Kong, and I am the Lord of the Huangcheng City."

Hearing this, everyone was shocked.

This mysterious strong man is actually the city lord.

I don’t know how many strong people the city lord has secretly cultivated, but it is definitely more than they imagined.

At this time, a vibration suddenly came from the depths of the void.

Everyone looked solemn, then turned around and looked.

boom!

"Reinforcements are here!!"

"well?"

The leader was a powerful man from the Divine Dynasty. Some of them were unresponsive when they looked at the people standing in the void watching the show.

Behind him, everyone in the Divine Prison was also a little confused.

Didn’t it mean that the war here is very fierce? What’s the situation?

"You guys are this?"

Jian Xin stepped forward and looked at the man from the Divine Dynasty and said in confusion.

"General Jian Xin, they were all released from the divine prison by His Highness Princess, and were ordered by His Highness Princess to come to support."

Hearing this, everyone immediately understood.

But now, it's nothing.

I was ready to say that it was nothing to them.

"It's nothing here anymore, you can go back."

After a moment of silence, Jian Xin finally chose to let these powerful people released from the divine prison return to the imperial capital.

When everyone in the Divine Prison heard Jian Xin's words, they looked ugly.

go back?

Go back to that dark cell?

How can they accept this? How can they finally come out? How can they bear to go back?

The man in charge pondered for a moment and suddenly said, "Let's go back."

Hearing this, everyone was stunned and finally followed the man's footsteps.

"Miss Jianxin, what do you think they will?"

Awei asked in the crowd.

Jian Xin had a sharp look, staring at the powerful people in the Divine Prison, and slowly said, "I believe that after so many years of detention, they should have understood some of the truth."

“So, they will make the right choice.”

Hearing this, Awei nodded and said nothing.

On the way.

"Senior, do we really have to go back to the Divine Prison?"

A Divine Prison strongman's face darkened slightly.

They thought that the leading man was the strongest, half a step into the mortal realm.

So they followed the man's opinion.

The man sneered: "If you want to go back to the cell, go back by yourself, I won't go back."

Hearing this, the man was shocked.

"Senior, now that the Divine Dynasty is so powerful, where can we escape to?"

"What the hell are you thinking?!"

The man said angrily.

"I mean to join the Divine Dynasty, who said I want to run away!"

Now everyone knows that the Divine Dynasty is powerful, and the Divine Dynasty has almost no opponents in the entire known star field.

Even the Soul Devouring Clan has fallen behind the Divine Dynasty.

So, there is no other way except to choose to join the Divine Dynasty.

After hearing the man's words, everyone was stunned and immediately began to ponder.

If they could join the Divine Dynasty, they would have joined long ago.

Over the years, there are fewer people in the Divine Prison.

They all couldn't hold on any longer and chose to join the Divine Dynasty.

And they were the ones who had held on.

But now, do they have to bow their heads in the end?

As if he saw the gloomy look on everyone's faces, the man said lightly: "Do you still remember the daughter of the Divine Dynasty Empress?"

Hearing this, everyone nodded and said: "Of course."

Everyone was impressed by Lu Xue.

Not only was she mysterious, but she was also very generous.

Her trump cards were endless.

The man continued: "The one I want to follow is that princess, but I'm not sure whether the other party will accept her or not."

Hearing this, everyone reacted.

If you can follow that princess, you will definitely have a bright future in the future.

And Lei Yin in the crowd was ecstatic.

At this moment, a sense of superiority arose spontaneously.

Hahaha, didn't expect it, luckily I have foresight.

.........

Above the void of the imperial capital.

Countless Divine Dynasty strongmen looked puzzled.

Who is that?

At this time, Lu Xue gave the answer.

"Dad, you're back."

Lu Xue looked at the figure behind the red-eyed man with red eyes, and the next moment, Lu Xue rushed towards him.

Just like that, Lu Xue passed by the red-eyed man.

But the red-eyed man did not react at all.

Because at this moment, he was shocked to find that he could no longer move.

Suddenly, a strong fear surged from his heart.

What kind of terrifying strong man is this.

"Xiaoxue."

With a puff, Lu Xue threw herself directly into Lu Daosheng's arms, and then separated immediately.

"Dad, you left for a long time this time."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's heart was a little throbbing.

"I'm back now."

Then, Lu Daosheng looked at the red-eyed man not far away.

At this moment, the red-eyed man was already sweating profusely.

"You,,"

"Dead man, no need to speak."

Tsk!

A head flew high into the air, and blood spilled into the air.
